properties.id: string native DOITT ID; also encoded as numeric MVT feature.id
properties.bin: native BIN string; omitted when unknown
properties.height_m: recorded roof height in feet × 0.3048; omitted means unknown/null, not zero
properties.feature_code: native OTI feature type; not a land-use or occupancy classification

method: All valid non-placeholder source footprints are clipped to buffered Web Mercator tile bounds, quantized to an 8192-unit tile grid, and encoded without simplification (tolerance 0). Native IDs are retained across clipped fragments. Every tile in the stated rectangle exists, including valid empty layers. No geographic or feature-density sampling is applied.
limitations: This is the preserved 2026-10-25 source revision retrieved on 2026-10-27, not a live or exhaustive survey of every physical structure.
The source includes garages, auxiliary structures and other OTI feature types. Seven invalid geometries and 34 placeholders are excluded from polygon display and remain in the full archive.
Tile clipping and coordinate quantization are for display and native-ID selection only. Fetch the authoritative full record before geometry measurements or site evidence analysis.
At this latitude, an 8192-unit z14 tile grid is approximately 0.23 m per unit. Overzoom adds display detail, not survey precision.
Repeated fragments at tile boundaries represent one native DOITT record, not additional buildings.
Roof height is not interior clear height; missing height does not imply a zero-height building.
